papers.title: Dynamic stress release via a mechano-photoisomerizable molecule for robust flexible perovskite/organic tandem solar cells
papers.summary: We developed a dynamic reversible stress-release strategy based on a mechano-photoisomerizable spiropyran molecule (SPMA) for mechanically robust flexible perovskite/organic TSCs. SPMA simultaneously induced the preferential (100) orientation, reduced intrinsic lattice strain, and facilitated continuous external stress dissipation. The resulting flexible perovskite/organic TSC achieved a record efficiency of 25.87% (certified 25.29%) and excellent mechanical stability.

papers.research_story:

作者将机械力-光异构化螺吡喃分子（SPMA）引入活性层，利用其可逆异构化实现动态应力释放，同时诱导钙钛矿(100)择优取向并降低本征晶格应变。

机理上，SPMA在外部应力下发生可逆结构转变，将局部应力耗散与晶格应变调控耦合。

所得柔性串联电池效率达25.87%（认证25.29%），为该类器件最高值，并显著提升机械稳定性。

该策略将分子力学响应与光电性能调控统一，为柔性多结光伏的应力管理提供了可推广的分子设计范式。

papers.title: Reconciling the surface and bulk oxygen vacancies in ITO for efficient inverted perovskite solar cells
papers.summary: Indium tin oxide is not merely a passive transparent substrate in inverted perovskite solar cells but actively participates in buried-interface formation through its oxygen-vacancy chemistry. By reconciling surface and bulk oxygen vacancies in ITO, this work couples robust self-assembled monolayer anchoring with favorable interfacial energetics, enabling efficient and stable devices through transparent-electrode defect engineering.

papers.title: Molecular locking of lithium ions for improved efficiency and stability of perovskite solar cells
papers.summary: The hole-transport material 2,2′,7,7′-tetrakis(N,N-di-p-methoxyphenyl-amine)-9,9′-spirobifluorene (Spiro-OMeTAD) is commonly used in perovskite solar cells but suffers from instabilities due to the hygroscopicity and lithium ion migration induced by additives, such as lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide and 4-tert-butylpyridine (tBP), in its formulation. Here we show a molecular locking strategy by designing phosphonate-based molecules with extended cyano chains, enabling dual-site coordination with lithium ions to regulate ion mobility and stabilize the lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide/tBP dopant environment. Meanwhile, the phosphonate-based molecule reduces tBP loss, enhances the thermomechanical robustness of the Spiro-OMeTAD matrix, mitigates dopant redistribution and stabilizes the interface. These coupled effects collectively improve device stability under illumination, thermal and electrical stresses. The optimized n–i–p perovskite solar cells achieve a champion efficiency of 26.73% and retain 95% of the initial efficiency after 1,000 h under maximum power point tracking (International Summit on Organic Photovoltaic Stability (ISOS)-L-1), 95% after 1,000 h at 85 °C (ISOS-L-2) and 91% after 1,600 h under 1.5 V bias (ISOS-V-1).
papers.authors: Tengfei Pan, Biyun Ren, Wan Yang et al.
papers.research_story:
该工作针对Spiro-OMeTAD中Li-TFSI/tBP掺杂体系因吸湿性和锂离子迁移引发的器件不稳定性问题，提出以延长氰基链的膦酸酯分子对锂离子实施双位点配位的“分子锁定”策略，同步调控离子迁移并稳定掺杂剂微环境。

机理上，该分子通过双位点配位锁定锂离子、抑制tBP挥发，增强Spiro-OMeTAD基体的热机械稳健性，抑制掺杂剂再分布并稳定界面，从而在光照、热及电应力下协同提升器件稳定性。

优化后的n–i–p型钙钛矿太阳能电池获得冠军效率（摘要未给出具体数值），并在多种应力条件下表现出优于常规掺杂体系的耐久性。

该策略将添加剂工程从单纯掺杂调控拓展至离子迁移的分子级锁定，为提升钙钛矿光伏器件运行稳定性提供了可迁移的分子设计思路。

papers.title: Polymerizable ionic buffers transform grain boundaries into ion-regulating interfaces in metal halide perovskites
papers.summary: Long-term operational instability remains a critical barrier for perovskite photovoltaics toward commercial deployment, originating largely from uncontrolled ionic migration across grain boundaries. Mobile A-site cations and halide ions transform grain boundaries in metal-halide perovskites into nanoscale ion-transport pathways, undermining device stability. Here, we develop a polymerizable imidazolium tetrafluoroborate ionic buffer that chemically stabilizes mobile A- and X-site species while physically confining grain-boundary pathways. The BF4− counterion interacts with undercoordinated Pb sites, whereas the propargyl-substituted imidazolium cation stabilizes organic A-site cations, suppresses deprotonation, and scavenges reactive iodine species. Upon post-deposition activation, the cation undergoes in situ polymerization within grain-boundary regions to form an amorphous intergranular network. Correlative nanoscale characterization reveals reduced ion redistribution, electrostatic heterogeneity, and local electrical hysteresis. The inverted perovskite solar cells reach 27.25% efficiency (certified 27.03%), while 13.95 cm2 modules achieve a certified 24.10% efficiency and retain 95% of their initial performance after 2000 h of continuous maximum power point tracking. Outdoor testing supports the practical viability of this grain-boundary protection strategy.

papers.title: An in situ redox-converted molecule for all-perovskite tandem solar cells
papers.summary: All-perovskite tandem solar cells (TSCs) are gaining prominence due to their ability to surpass the efficiency limit of single-junction perovskite solar cells (PSCs)1,2. However, the efficiency and stability of all-perovskite TSCs are limited by chemical instability at the hole transport layer/perovskite interface in the tin-lead (Sn-Pb) narrow-bandgap subcell, which introduces deep trap states from tin cations and promotes non-radiative recombination3-5. Here we incorporate a redox-converted molecule of p-aminobenzohydrazide (ABH) into poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene):polystyrene sulfonate (PEDOT:PSS) that neutralizes PSS acidity, heals Sn4+ defects, and generates a dipole passivation effect upon oxidation. During the preparation of Sn-Pb perovskites, ABH suppresses interfacial oxidation by reducing Sn4+ defects and converts to p-aminobenzaldehyde (ABD), which suppresses photogenerated hole-induced Sn2+ oxidation, aligning energy levels for efficient hole extraction. The in situ redox-converted molecule stabilizes the buried interface during both device fabrication and operation, reduces non-radiative recombination and enhances stability. The resulting narrow-bandgap Sn-Pb PSC achieves a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 25.4% (certified 25.2%) with an open-circuit voltage of 0.92 V and a fill factor of 83.4%. Integrated into monolithic all-perovskite TSCs, the device delivers a PCE of 31.1% (certified 30.8%) together with enhanced thermal (ISOS-D-2I, 85 °C) and operational stability (ISOS-L-1I) under inert conditions.

1.79 eV子电池实现21.02%效率（V_OC 1.375 V），65°C MPPT下T90超800 h，单片钙钛矿-有机叠层效率达27.5%。

该策略为宽禁带钙钛矿的界面氧化还原工程提供了可推广范式，实质性推进了叠层电池的效率-稳定性协同提升。

该工作针对倒置钙钛矿电池中界面电子提取效率不足与能级失配制约开路电压和填充因子的瓶颈。

作者构建定向钙钛矿—富勒烯电子穿梭通道，通过分子取向调控实现界面能级连续过渡与缺陷钝化协同。

机理上，定向富勒烯层加速电子抽取并抑制界面非辐射复合，显著降低电压损失。

器件效率达27.2%，为倒置结构最高水平之一。

该策略为界面电子传输的定向设计提供了可推广范式。
